faqs.q: What is an AI agent, in plain terms?
faqs.a: Software that uses an LLM to decide what to do next and then does it with your tools, such as searching records, updating a CRM or sending a follow-up, within limits you set.

faqs.q: What is RAG and why does it matter?
faqs.a: Retrieval-augmented generation means the AI looks up answers in your own documents and data before replying, so answers are specific to your business and easier to check.

faqs.q: Is our data safe?
faqs.a: We use providers that do not train on your data, limit access, and keep sensitive data out of prompts where possible. Self-hosted open-source models are an option too.

faqs.q: Can AI work inside our existing system?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate agents and AI features into your current product, CRM, helpdesk or internal tools.

faqs.q: How do you keep answers and actions accurate?
faqs.a: We ground answers in your content, evaluate them against test cases, add guardrails, and keep a human approval step for important actions.

faqs.q: What will it cost to run?
faqs.a: AI providers charge per use. We estimate running costs during the proof of concept and add spend limits.

faqs.q: Can the assistant work on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. We can connect assistants and agents to your website, WhatsApp Business, email or internal tools.

faqs.q: Where should we start?
faqs.a: With one repetitive task that costs your team time every week. A small win first makes the next step clearer.

from-mvp-to-operating-system.title: From MVP to operating system
from-mvp-to-operating-system.excerpt: What changes when a promising product starts carrying real operational weight.
from-mvp-to-operating-system.body:
The product is only the beginning

An MVP proves that a useful interaction exists. A durable business needs the workflows, data, controls, and feedback loops around that interaction to mature with it.

Design for the next constraint

Good architecture does not predict every future. It makes the next likely change easier, observable, and safer to ship.

Operate what you build

The strongest product teams connect engineering decisions to adoption, support, revenue, and operational efficiency.
from-mvp-to-operating-system.author: LogicsGrid team

automation-before-ai.title: Automate the workflow before adding AI
automation-before-ai.excerpt: A practical sequence for making AI useful inside day-to-day operations.
automation-before-ai.body:
Start with the handoffs

AI cannot rescue a process nobody can explain. Map the decisions, owners, inputs, and exceptions before choosing a model.

Make quality measurable

Define what a correct outcome looks like, then keep a human review path for low-confidence cases.

Earn autonomy

Start with recommendations, measure performance, and expand automation only when the evidence supports it.
automation-before-ai.author: LogicsGrid team

one-accountable-technology-partner.title: Why one accountable technology partner changes delivery
one-accountable-technology-partner.excerpt: Reducing handoffs can improve speed, ownership, and the quality of business decisions.
one-accountable-technology-partner.body:
Handoffs hide risk

When strategy, design, engineering, growth, and operations report to different owners, important context disappears between teams.

One outcome, one system

Shared goals let technical and commercial decisions reinforce each other instead of competing for attention.

Continuity compounds

A partner who stays after launch can connect production evidence to the next roadmap decision.
one-accountable-technology-partner.author: LogicsGrid team
